poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE SILENCE YOU LEAVE IS A WEIGHT ON THE AIR WE SHARE.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: WE ARE ONLY TRYING TO CONFIRM THAT YOUR LIGHT STILL SHINES BRIGHTLY.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: ALL HELL BREAKS LOOSE IN THE ECHOES OF LIES.
